path.description: Any local `.java` file in the target workspace. This path is used to infer the workspace root and locate JDTLS.

workdir.description: Working directory for resolving relative paths. Defaults to the agent's current working directory. If provided, relative paths resolve from that directory.

target.description: A raw `jdt://` URI, a workspace symbol output line, or a `file://` / `.class` path.
